label: Fires at D2 when a2 led rarely to S1, stronger after a rewarded trial.
explanation: Silent at D1 and GO. At D2 the magnitude is almost entirely set by the a2 -> S1 rare transition (one indicator gives dev R^2 0.66 beyond timing). Within those steps it is larger when the previous trial was rewarded (+~1.0), and slightly larger when the observer belief favours S2 (negative belief_lo; adds little). The free fit adds the previous choice being a2 (+), previous state S1 (-) and previous transition common (-), reaching dev 0.74 vs 0.735 for the short form. Leftover errors: some a1 -> S1 common trials fire strongly (about 2) and some late-episode a2 -> S1 trials stay silent; observed history does not capture these, so the policy decile (model output, 0.77) explains more. The activation also falls late in the episode, which the timing baseline handles.

issues: The label leaves out the belief term, and the explanation undersells it. In the scored short form the belief term adds more than the prev_reward term. Test R^2 beyond timing for the a2->S1 indicator alone is 0.633. Adding prev_reward gives 0.685 (+0.05); adding belief_lo instead gives 0.703 (+0.07). Within the 3-term form, dropping belief_lo costs 0.041 (0.726 -> 0.685) and dropping prev_reward costs 0.023 (0.726 -> 0.703). So 'adds little' is wrong for belief_lo, and the label names only the weaker modulator.

The claim that the late-episode drop is 'covered by the timing baseline' is false. The baseline is additive per (phase, decile), so it spreads the late-episode loss across all D2 steps. It does not model the a2->S1 response itself dying out. Replacing the prev_reward term with (in_state==1)*(in_action==2)*(ep_trial>=80) raises test R^2 from 0.726 to 0.757. That beats the free fit (0.736) and the 'all observed' additive table (0.74). A linear ep_trial interaction gives 0.746 (weight -0.017 per trial). misses on the recorded form confirms this: its worst windows are a2->S1 trials at t90-99 that are predicted ~1.7-2.4 but are actually 0.

Systematic error that remains in every form tried: whole runs of a1->S1 common D2 steps fire at about 2 but are predicted at about 0.33 (the worst-fit windows at t25-29 and t41-45). Observed belief terms do not capture it. Adding (phase==D2)*(in_state==1)*belief_lo gives 0.716-0.717, below the recorded 0.726. This class looks small (the mean residual for a1 S1 is -0.23), but it is real.
Smaller check: the free fit's previous-choice term adds almost nothing in the short form (prev_action==2: 0.703 vs 0.703 without it). The interpretation does not depend on it.
skeptic.revised_label: Fires at D2 after a2->S1 rare transitions, more when belief favours S2; silent late-episode.
